description: Score conservation of ADCK1 catalytic and nucleotide-binding positions across 91 metazoan orthologs
code:
exec(open("lib.py").read())
import json, numpy as np, time
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
seqs=load_seqs(); adck1=seqs["ADCK1_HUMAN"]
keep=json.load(open("adck1_orthologs_metazoa.json"))
t=time.time()
cols=np.empty((len(keep),len(adck1)),dtype='<U1')
for i,k in enumerate(keep):
    mp=map_ref(adck1,k['seq'])
    cols[i]=[mp.get(p,'-') for p in range(1,len(adck1)+1)]
print("mapped %d orthologs in %.1fs"%(len(keep),time.time()-t))
cons=np.array([ (cols[:,j]==adck1[j]).mean()*100 for j in range(len(adck1)) ])
np.save("adck1_ortholog_conservation.npy",cons)
cov=np.array([ (cols[:,j]!='-').mean()*100 for j in range(len(adck1)) ])

MOTIF={
 'KxGQ K102':102,'KxGQ x103':103,'KxGQ G104':104,'KxGQ Q105':105,
 'A-loop L161':161,'A-loop G162':162,'A-loop T163':163,'A-loop A164':164,'A-loop S165':165,
 'GQ-motif A167':167,'GQ-motif Q168':168,'V169':169,
 'b3 A181':181,'b3 Lys K183':183,'aC Glu E236':236,
 'cat-loop D315':315,'cat-loop N320':320,
 'DFG-like D338':338,'DFG-like H339':339,'DFG-like G340':340,
}
print("\nConservation across %d metazoan ADCK1 orthologs (identity to human residue):"%len(keep))
rows=[]
for lbl,p in MOTIF.items():
    aa=adck1[p-1]
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(cols[:,p-1]); tot=sum(v for k2,v in c.items() if k2!='-')
    top=", ".join(f"{k2}:{100*v/max(tot,1):.0f}%" for k2,v in c.most_common(3) if k2!='-')
    rows.append((lbl,p,aa,cons[p-1],cov[p-1],top))
    print("  %-16s %s%-4d  identical in %5.1f%% (coverage %5.1f%%)   top: %s"%(lbl,aa,p,cons[p-1],cov[p-1],top))
json.dump([[r[0],r[1],r[2],round(float(r[3]),1),round(float(r[4]),1),r[5]] for r in rows],open("adck1_motif_conservation.json","w"),indent=1)
core=cons[99:400]
print("\nBackground: mean identity over kinase core (res 100-400) = %.1f%% ; median %.1f%% ; 90th pct %.1f%%"%(core.mean(),np.median(core),np.percentile(core,90)))
print("Fraction of core positions >=95%% identical: %.1f%%"%(100*(core>=95).mean()))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,7),height_ratios=[2,1.2])
ax[0].plot(np.arange(1,len(adck1)+1),cons,lw=0.7,color='#4C78A8')
ax[0].set_xlim(1,len(adck1)); ax[0].set_ylim(0,103)
ax[0].set_ylabel("% identity to human ADCK1\n(91 metazoan orthologs)")
ax[0].set_xlabel("Human ADCK1 residue")
for lbl,p in MOTIF.items():
    ax[0].plot([p],[cons[p-1]],'o',ms=5,color='#E45756')
for p,txt in [(102,'KxGQ'),(164,'A-rich loop'),(183,'β3 K183'),(236,'αC E236'),(315,'D315'),(338,'D338')]:
    ax[0].annotate(txt,(p,cons[p-1]),textcoords="offset points",xytext=(0,9),ha='center',fontsize=8,color='#E45756')
ax[0].set_title("Catalytic and nucleotide-binding positions of human ADCK1 are near-invariant across Metazoa")
names=[r[0] for r in rows]; vals=[r[3] for r in rows]
ax[1].bar(range(len(rows)),vals,color=['#E45756' if v>=95 else '#F58518' if v>=80 else '#9D9D9D' for v in vals])
ax[1].axhline(np.median(core),ls='--',c='k',lw=1,label="median identity, kinase core (%.0f%%)"%np.median(core))
ax[1].set_xticks(range(len(rows))); ax[1].set_xticklabels(names,rotation=60,ha='right',fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_ylabel("% identical"); ax[1].set_ylim(0,105); ax[1].legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
